notes.title: New art for: Artificial Life 2061 - Cybersys
AI programs will be helping me to design the characters for the chapter 2
notes.content:
And also with the help of many AI, I´m improving graphics, sounds, music, promotional material, concept designs, and more. 

The demo will be delayed as the game receives many boosts, but I assure you it will be worth it.  

I'm even adding some AI-generated images in the save game wait times and probably also in the start menu or the icons inside the game, also I'm testing to improve the enemies, and a lot of improvements are coming- 

And don´t worry, this is not to save work, it is to improve the work that was already done by myself :)
